title: I take ownership — fully.
description: On two separate projects I was the only developer. I scoped, built, shipped, and owned the outcome from start to finish. No safety net.

title: I get close to the problem first.
description: I do not touch the code until I understand what actually needs to be built and why. The best solutions come from sitting with the problem long enough.

title: I think in data flows, not just UI states.
description: Before I build a component, I ask where the data comes from, how it should be shaped, and what happens when it changes. The UI is the last step.

title: I test for hesitation, not just bugs.
description: If a user might pause, I rethink it. If something feels slightly off I fix it. Clarity and feel matter as much as correctness.
